method: Main-process [timing] JSON logs. click -> home hide -> capture -> overlay window ready -> overlay visible -> first frame. Realtime additionally: first OCR -> first subtitle. Cold = first run/overlay not prewarmed; warm = prewarmed/reused overlay. QA used a separate userData/temp instance; live app state untouched.
source_changes: Overlay screen capture now uses the existing OCR worker GDI capture action (CopyFromScreen) with a full-resolution PNG written to temp; no desktopCapturer full-screen thumbnail.
Overlay preview is a 1.25x DIP JPEG Buffer sent over IPC and decoded as a blob: URL before overlay:ready; full-res NativeImage remains in main for OCR cropping.
Overlay windows are prewarmed at startup (default 1.8s) and reused per display; reset on overlay:init/overlay:reset.
Realtime window enumeration is deferred until after the capture and sent to overlays via overlay:windows; overlay appears before the list is ready.
Realtime hides the main window before capture; restores on cancel, engine/OCR failure, or stop; screenshot flow unchanged but now shares the same callbacks.
Realtime OCR text is tail-limited to 8 lines / 800 chars before translation.
Added [timing] marks and an internal SL_PREWARM_DELAY_MS QA hook.

verification.multi_display_physical: not available on this machine; per-display prewarm/overlay and display add/remove handlers reviewed
